content: Official Supabase docs describe email/password auth, a server-only admin invitation API, and database RLS that can enforce access at row level; its service_role bypasses RLS and must remain server-side. This makes identity, invitation acceptance, tenant membership and recipe access authorization separate design concerns, not client-only UI checks. Supabase is an example, not an approved stack. Sources: supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/passwords; supabase.com/docs/reference/javascript/auth-admin-inviteuserbyemail; supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security
